findings.sectionRef: Dual-repo split > Job B / Approach > Architecture
findings.description: overview-init --force applies to .ralph-overview/data.json (:97) and config.json (:98) via planTemplate; running it against codexu to replace bin/ralph-overview.mjs would overwrite codexu's 135-task hand-curated data.json/config.json. Neither bare (errors on conflict :134) nor --force (data loss) is safe for adoption.
findings.resolution: Architecture #5 makes the wrapper+scripts emit force-scoped INDEPENDENTLY of the scaffold data/config templates. Job B uses a wrapper-scoped emit (never blanket --force). Added AC: codexu data.json byte-identical (sha256) after adoption; config.json differs only by the consumerWrapper merge.
findings.suggestedFix: Separate wrapper force path; AC proving data/config unchanged.

findings.description: Proposed ESM script guard import.meta.url === process.argv[1] compares a file:// URL to a filesystem path and is always false, so the emitted wrapper would never dispatch.
findings.resolution: Architecture #1 uses fileURLToPath(import.meta.url) === path.resolve(process.argv[1]) (with realpath option). AC adds a CLI spawn test proving the emitted wrapper actually dispatches and forwards exit code.

findings.description: scripts/sync-ralph-state.mjs:13 statically imports watch-ralph-state.mjs which statically imports chokidar (:6); so one-shot sync (no --watch) loads chokidar and fails on a fresh Copilot install without node_modules. The diagnostic-only decision therefore does not make non-watch sync work today.
findings.resolution: Added Architecture #8: lazy-load the watch module via dynamic import() only on the --watch path (new US-006). Reconciliation decision now conditioned on this fix. AC adds: one-shot sync succeeds under a fake install with node_modules absent; watch surfaces the deps-missing diagnostic.
findings.suggestedFix: Lazy-load watch code only for --watch; or weaken claim/AC.

findings.description: The 'forced mid-operation failure leaves neither' atomicity AC over-claims cross-file transactional atomicity; init-consumer writes per-op and atomicWriteFile is per-file only, so once the first rename succeeds a true two-file transaction is not achievable as written, making the AC unimplementable/unverifiable.
findings.resolution: Architecture #4 defines an ordered preflight contract (plan both -> preflight fail-together -> write wrapper FIRST -> only then write package.json), and the AC is reworded to the verifiable invariant: package.json scripts are never written unless the wrapper write already succeeded (no scripts-without-wrapper half-state), and if package.json is absent neither is written. Test injects a wrapper-write failure and asserts package.json untouched.
findings.suggestedFix: Define the transaction/ordering mechanism or relax the guarantee to preflight + safe ordering.

findings.description: Plan omits skills/overview-init/SKILL.md and its generated Copilot mirror, which document --add-package-json-scripts as 'only adds scripts' and --force as 'overwrites scaffold only' — both wrong once the flag emits a wrapper and force-scoping changes.
findings.resolution: Added US-007: update skills/overview-init/SKILL.md and regenerate .copilot-plugin/copilot-skills/overview-init/SKILL.md via scripts/generate-copilot-artifacts.mjs --write. Added to Files list + AC.
findings.suggestedFix: Regenerate the skill + mirror in lockstep.

findings.description: Job B's 'overview-init --force then config hook' order is unsafe; config/data preservation and the dry-run proof must come before any write.
findings.resolution: Job B reordered: US-009 dry-run delta validation (prove only wrapper+scripts+intentional config merge) runs first; US-010 applies the wrapper-scoped emit; never blanket --force.

findings.description: The wrapper reading .ralph-overview/config.json via a hardcoded path conflicts with the plugin resolver's configPath/OVERVIEW_CONFIG_PATH precedence, so wrapper selection can diverge from the plugin's actual loaded config.
findings.resolution: Architecture #6: single loadConsumerWrapperConfig(repoRoot, env) helper resolves the config path with the SAME precedence (OVERVIEW_CONFIG_PATH then <repoRoot>/.ralph-overview/config.json) and passes that same path to the child as OVERVIEW_CONFIG_PATH, so wrapper and plugin read one source.
findings.suggestedFix: Match precedence; pass resolved path down.

findings.description: New consumerWrapper config keys need a schema test asserting the block is accepted by overview-config.schema.json (additionalProperties:false).
findings.resolution: US-004 + AC add a schema-validation test asserting consumerWrapper.localDevPluginRootRel validates.

findings.description: Job B says preserve codexu's extra scripts but Job A only manages 4; needs explicit handling of overview:dev and overview:build:preview during adoption.
findings.resolution: Job B explicitly preserves overview:dev and overview:build:preview (init merges only the 4 managed keys; both already call node bin/ralph-overview.mjs so they keep working).

findings.description: resolvePluginRoot accepting cwd+config while the wrapper also reads config.json risks duplicated repo-root/config resolution logic.
findings.resolution: Architecture #6 introduces a single small loadConsumerWrapperConfig(repoRoot, env) helper inside the template; tests drive that surface.

findings.description: Signal-forwarding AC underspecified; should name SIGINT/SIGTERM and child exit-by-signal behavior, noting Windows limitations.
findings.resolution: AC now names SIGINT forwarding + child exit-code forwarding and documents the Windows SIGTERM best-effort/kill caveat.

findings.description: additionalProbePaths is broader than the only current need (localDevPluginRootRel); adds resolver-precedence + validation surface with no consumer.
findings.resolution: Deferred additionalProbePaths; the initial consumerWrapper schema ships only localDevPluginRootRel. Documented as a future extension. Moved to Out of Scope.

findings.description: codexu submodule gitlink bump mentioned only as a lead step, not a concrete Job B change/AC; needs a gate that ai-developer-toolkit points at the v2.9.0 commit before codexu AGENTS.md is set to 2.9.0.
findings.resolution: US-011 makes the gitlink bump a concrete Job B step; AC gates the AGENTS.md version row on the gitlink pointing at the v2.9.0 toolkit commit.

findings.description: 'overview-init --dry-run enumerates the exact deltas' is not testable: initConsumer reports planned/skipped/errors, not diffs, and --diff does not exist.
findings.resolution: AC replaced with concrete assertions on --dry-run --json output (planned ops touch only bin + package.json + intentional config merge; data.json skipped/unchanged) plus a sha256 of data.json before/after.
findings.suggestedFix: Assert JSON output + file hashes + unchanged data.json.

findings.description: The missing-deps diagnostic AC only checks selection/diagnostic, not real subcommand behavior under a missing-node_modules install.
findings.resolution: Tied to F-003: AC now also asserts one-shot sync succeeds and watch surfaces the diagnostic under a fake install with node_modules absent (after the lazy-load fix).
findings.suggestedFix: Add real-subcommand AC under missing node_modules.
